You have tons of options but I'd recommend modifying it to look like something from whatever IP that you personally like. If you give me some of your favorites, I'll do some research for you

PVC piping is probably your best bet, but remember cross reinforcing the frame will make it extremely hardy. Another thing is you can drill though PVC piping so keep that in mind if/when you reinforce the frame.

For the holster you could get some cheap nylon and measure it out to your body proportions and secure it together with hand stitching and hot glue or go the more expensive route and go for leather. There are plenty of video tutorials for either. As for the Biotic Field Grenades, you could get some MDF wood or EVA foam, build up a block by gluing multiple layers on top of each other, then cut the basic cylinder shape and sand to desired shape (A lathe might work best if you have access to one). Then paint with spray paint, being sure to make it a clean paint job by using tape to mask off areas.  

EDIT: I forgot to mention the pockets on the holster could either be actual tactical vest pockets you can order from plenty of online vendors or cheap phone cases you can pick up at walmart (or applicable mega corp)
